about.heading: Design with *purpose.*
about.body:
I'm Edwin Dol, a website designer who believes a great website should do more than look good — it should help your business grow. I combine clean design, smooth user experience and solid code to build sites that feel effortless to use.

When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring new design trends, gaming, or sketching ideas for the next project.
